evidence_summary: Cluster POL-580 (POL-581..POL-585) added Paperclip role-based assignee routing: PaperclipExecutionConfig gained optional roleBindings/reportsTo fields (schema.json, schema.ts), PaperclipAdapter gained resolveAssigneeForRole() (direct binding, then reportsTo org-chain fallback, then assigneeAgentId), an advisory ROLE_SKILL_ROUTING hint embedded in issue bodies, and a work-product-evidence gate that downgrades a Paperclip 'done' status lacking PR/commit/branch/attachment evidence to a worker-failure. Reconciled src/loop/adapters/POLARIS.md and SUMMARY.md (paperclip.ts was previously undocumented in the adapters route despite pre-existing in the tree) and src/config/POLARIS.md and SUMMARY.md (new config fields). test/config/POLARIS.md and SUMMARY.md remain an unreconciled draft template but only a test file was added there with no folder-level behavior change, so left as-is per reconciliation rules. No smartdocs/raw candidates correspond to this cluster's work, so no ingestion occurred. One blocker recorded: execution-adapters.md spec does not yet cover the Paperclip adapter generally; this predates this cluster and exceeds route-local reconciliation scope, flagged for operator/analysis follow-up. Committed all four doc updates as a single librarian commit.
